{{Quote|Stare any harder and it'll evaporate.|Tolk le Trene teasing Jos Vondar, who was staring into his Tanque tea|audio=StareAnyHarderAndItllEvaporate-MedStarI.flac|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
'''Tanque tea''' was a variety of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] with a murky appearance, due to [[Plant/Legends|root]] fragments used in its preparation. Some of the root fragments floated at the surface of the tea and were visible to the unaided [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] had Tanque tea in the chow hall of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]], a medical facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. He shared the tea with his [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] assistant, [[Tolk le Trene]], a member of the Human [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] race.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanque tea appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MedStar I" />
